GearsApi.summary: The game's `IModApi` entry point for `GearsAPI.dll` itself. Not intended for use by mods.
GearsApi.description:
The game's `IModApi` entry point for `GearsAPI.dll` itself. It logs the GearsAPI version when
the game loads the assembly. Not intended for use by mods.

members.GearsApi(): Initializes a new instance. Called by the game's mod loader.
members.InitMod(Mod): Logs `[Gears API] Gears API version <version> loaded`. Implements `IModApi.InitMod`.

GearsSettingsManager.summary: Static access to every mod Gears knows about, without waiting for a callback.
GearsSettingsManager.description:
Static access to every mod Gears knows about, for code that wants a setting without waiting for
an [`IGearsModApi`](/docs/reference/settings/i-gears-mod-api) callback. Populated by Gears at `GameAwake`; before that, both methods
return empty results.

members.GetMods(): Returns every loaded mod as a `List<`[`IGearsMod`](/docs/reference/settings/i-gears-mod)`>`, in the game's load order. Returns an empty list before Gears has initialised.
members.GetGearsMod(String): Returns the [`IGearsMod`](/docs/reference/settings/i-gears-mod) whose `ModInfo.xml` `<Name>` equals `modName`, or `null` if there is none or Gears has not initialised.

IGearsMod.summary: What Gears knows about one loaded mod: its settings trees, icon and banner.
IGearsMod.description:
What Gears knows about one loaded mod: the game's `Mod`, its global and world settings, and the
optional icon and banner declared in `ModInfo.xml`. Handed to
[`IGearsModApi`](/docs/reference/settings/i-gears-mod-api)`.InitMod` and returned by [`GearsSettingsManager`](/docs/reference/settings/gears-settings-manager).

members.Mod: Gets the game's `Mod` object for this mod.
members.GlobalSettings: Gets the mod's global settings tree as an [`IModGlobalSettings`](/docs/reference/global/i-mod-global-settings). Never `null`; empty for a mod that declares none.
members.WorldSettings: Gets the mod's world settings tree as an [`IModWorldSettings`](/docs/reference/world/i-mod-world-settings). Never `null`; empty for a mod that declares none.
members.BannerPath: Gets or sets the banner image path, relative to the mod folder. Seeded from `<Banner value>` in `ModInfo.xml`.
members.IconPath: Gets or sets the icon image path, relative to the mod folder. Seeded from `<Icon value>` in `ModInfo.xml`.
members.HasGearsApi(): Returns `true` if at least one [`IGearsModApi`](/docs/reference/settings/i-gears-mod-api) implementation was found in the mod's assemblies.
members.HasGlobalSettings(): Returns `true` if the mod has at least one global tab.
members.HasWorldSettings(): Returns `true` if the mod has at least one world setting.
members.HasBanner(): Returns `true` if `BannerPath` is set and the file exists.
members.HasIcon(): Returns `true` if `IconPath` is set and the file exists.
members.SaveSettings(): Writes the player-level saved settings file now, including this mod's current global values. Returns `true` if the file exists afterwards.

IGearsModApi.summary: The callback contract a C# mod implements to be told about its settings.
IGearsModApi.description:
The callback contract a C# mod implements to be told about its settings. Gears scans every
assembly of a mod for concrete classes implementing this interface, instantiates each through its
public parameterless constructor, and invokes every callback on every instance. See
[C# Getting Started](/docs/csharp/getting-started) for the order and timing.

members.InitMod(IGearsMod): Called at `GameAwake` after all `IGearsModApi` instances exist and before any `ModSettings.xml` is read. The settings tree is empty; create settings from code here.
members.OnGlobalSettingsLoaded(IModGlobalSetting: Called once every mod's `ModSettings.xml` has been parsed and the player's saved global values restored. Global values are final from here.
members.OnWorldSettingsLoaded(IModWorldSettings): Called when a world's settings become known: on world start when hosting, when the server's settings arrive when joining, or after a reset to defaults when the server sent none. May fire more than once per session. Not called for a mod with no world settings.

IModSetting.summary: The members every setting shares, including categories.
IModSetting.description:
The members every setting shares, including categories: identity, display text, enabled state,
the change flags, preview images, and the three operations the settings window performs.

members.Name: Gets the setting's identity within its category. The `name` attribute in XML.
members.DisplayKey: Gets the localization key for the label. Falls back to `Name` when empty.
members.CaptionKey: Gets or sets the localization key for the short heading in the description pane.
members.DescriptionKey: Gets or sets the localization key for the description text.
members.Enabled: Gets or sets whether the setting can be changed in the menu. Starts `true`.
members.IsChanged: Gets whether the selected value differs from the applied value.
members.IsDefault: Gets whether the applied value equals the default value.
members.OnEnabled: Occurs when `Enabled` changes to a different value. Type [`OnSettingEnabledEvent`](/docs/reference/settings/on-setting-enabled-event).
members.GetDisplayName(): Returns the localized label: `Localization.Get(DisplayKey)`, or of `Name` when the key is empty.
members.HasCaption(): Returns `true` if `CaptionKey` is set and not whitespace.
members.GetCaptionText(): Returns the localized caption, or the display name when there is no caption.
members.HasDescription(): Returns `true` if `DescriptionKey` is set and not whitespace.
members.HasPreviews(): Returns `true` if the setting has any preview image.
members.GetCurrentPreview(): Returns the image path for the selected value, or the setting's own image when none is keyed to that value.
members.AddPreview(String): Sets the setting's own preview image path. The last call wins.
members.ResetToDefault(): Sets the selected value to the default value. The applied value is untouched.
members.DiscardCurrentChange(): Sets the selected value back to the applied value.
members.ApplyCurrentChange(): Commits the selected value as the applied value, raising `OnValueChanged` and, on a global setting, `OnSettingChanged`.

OnSettingEnabledEvent.description:
Handler for [`IModSetting`](/docs/reference/settings/i-mod-setting)`.OnEnabled`. Raised only when `Enabled` is assigned a value
different from the current one.

members.param:setting: The setting whose enabled state changed.

IValueModSetting<T>.summary: A setting that holds a value of type `T`: the default, the applied value and the selected value.
IValueModSetting<T>.description:
A setting that holds a value of type `T`: the default, the applied value and the value currently
selected in the UI. Implemented by every Selector, Slider, Switch and Color setting.
IValueModSetting<T>.typeParams: `T` — the value type; `int`, `float`, `string`, `bool`, `UnityEngine.Color` or an enum.

members.SettingValue: Gets or sets the applied value: what is saved to disk, returned by `modsetting()`, and what a mod should act on. Setting it to an equal value is a no-op.
members.DefaultValue: Gets or sets the value `ResetToDefault()` returns to.
members.SelectedValue: Gets or sets the value currently picked in the UI, possibly not yet applied. Setting it to an equal value is a no-op.
members.OnSelected: Occurs when `SelectedValue` changes to a different value. Type [`ValueSelectedEvent<T>`](/docs/reference/settings/value-selected-event).
members.GetPreview(T): Returns the preview image path registered for `value`, or `null`.
members.AddPreview(T, String): Registers an image to show while `value` is selected. The first image registered for a value wins.

SettingRestartScope.summary: What a change to a global setting costs the player.
SettingRestartScope.description:
What a change to a global setting costs the player. Shown as a warning in the settings window;
Gears does not itself reload or restart anything. Used by [`IGlobalModSetting`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-mod-setting)`.RestartScope`.

members.None: The change takes effect without a reload.
members.Reload: The change needs the world to be reloaded.
members.Restart: The change needs the game to be restarted.

IValueModSettingBase.summary: The non-generic face of a value setting: string in, string out.
IValueModSettingBase.description:
The non-generic face of a value setting, for code that handles settings without knowing their
value type: string in, string out, through the type's registered parser and formatter.

members.SetSettingValueFromString(String): Parses `raw` with the value type's parser and assigns the applied value. An unparseable string is logged and the value is left unchanged.
members.SetDefaultValueFromString(String): Parses `raw` and assigns the default value. Same failure handling.
members.SetSelectedValueFromString(String): Parses `raw` and assigns the selected value. Same failure handling.
members.GetUiFormattedSettingValue(): Returns the applied value as the player sees it: formatted with the UI formatter, prefixed with the localization prefix and passed through `Localization.Get`.
members.GetFormattedSelectedValue(): Returns the selected value as the player sees it.
members.GetSerializedFormattedSettingValue(): Returns the applied value as written to the saved settings file and returned by `modsetting()`: formatted with the serialization formatter, no localization.

ISelectorSettingBase.summary: The non-generic members of a Selector: display, storage and selection by position.
ISelectorSettingBase.description:
The non-generic members of a Selector: how its values are displayed and stored, and selection by
position.

members.UiFormatter: Gets or sets the .NET format string used when a value is shown to the player. Honoured by numeric types only. Changing it rebuilds the display strings.
members.SerializationFormatter: Gets or sets the .NET format string used when the value is saved or read by `modsetting()`. Numeric types only.
members.LocalizationPrefix: Gets or sets the text prepended to each formatted value, with no separator, before it is looked up as a localization key. Changing it rebuilds the display strings.
members.Wrap: Gets or sets whether stepping past the last value returns to the first.
members.GetAllowedValuesDisplay(): Returns the allowed values as the player sees them, in the same order as the typed `GetAllowedValues()`. Built on first use and cached until the values, formatter or prefix change.
members.SelectByIndex(Int32): Sets the selected value to the allowed value at `index`. Throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` if `index` is outside the allowed values.

ISliderSettingBase.summary: The non-generic members of a Slider.
ISliderSettingBase.description: The non-generic members of a Slider.

members.UiFormatter: Gets or sets the .NET format string used when the value is shown to the player.
members.SerializationFormatter: Gets or sets the .NET format string used when the value is saved or read by `modsetting()`.

ISwitchSettingBase.summary: The non-generic members of a Switch: the two buttons, their text, and which one is lit.
ISwitchSettingBase.description: The non-generic members of a Switch: the two buttons, their text, and which one is lit.

members.LocalizationPrefix: Gets or sets the text prepended to each side's formatted value, with no separator, before it is looked up as a localization key.
members.GetLeftText(): Returns the localized text for the left value.
members.GetRightText(): Returns the localized text for the right value.
members.SelectButton(SelectedButton): Sets the selected value to the value on that side.
members.GetSelectedButton(): Returns [`SelectedButton`](/docs/reference/base/i-switch-setting-base-selected-button)`.Right` when the selected value equals the right value and not the left value; otherwise `Left`. Derived from the value on every call.

ISwitchSettingBase.SelectedButton.summary: Which side of a Switch is lit.
ISwitchSettingBase.SelectedButton.description:
Which side of a Switch is lit. Nested in [`ISwitchSettingBase`](/docs/reference/base/i-switch-setting-base); write
`ISwitchSettingBase.SelectedButton.Left` or add
`using static GearsAPI.Settings.Base.ISwitchSettingBase;`.
ISwitchSettingBase.SelectedButton.note: Declared inside the interface without an explicit `public` modifier — nested interface types are implicitly public.

members.Right: The right button, holding `RightValue`. For a `bool` switch, `true`.
members.Left: The left button, holding `LeftValue`. For a `bool` switch, `false`. Also the resting position when the selected value matches neither side.

IModGlobalSettings.summary: The root of a mod's global settings: the tabs, and operations across the whole tree.
IModGlobalSettings.description:
The root of a mod's global settings: the tabs, and operations across the whole tree. Handed to
[`IGearsModApi`](/docs/reference/settings/i-gears-mod-api)`.OnGlobalSettingsLoaded`; also [`IGearsMod`](/docs/reference/settings/i-gears-mod)`.GlobalSettings`.

members.CreateTab(String): Creates a tab whose display key is its name. Throws `ArgumentException` if a tab with that name exists.
members.CreateTab(String, String): Creates a tab with the given name and display key. Throws `ArgumentException` on a duplicate name.
members.GetOrCreateTab(String): Returns the existing tab named `name`, or creates it with its name as display key.
members.GetOrCreateTab(String, String): Returns the existing tab named `name`, or creates it with the given display key.
members.GetAllGlobalSettings(): Returns every setting in every category of every tab, categories included, as a `List<`[`IGlobalModSetting`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-mod-setting)`>`.
members.BindSettingsClass(Type): Scans `settingsType` for tagged static members carrying a `"Tab.Category.Setting"` path. Fields and properties tagged [`[Setting]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-attribute) are assigned the named setting first, then methods tagged [`[SettingOnValueChanged]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-on-value-changed-attribute), [`[SettingOnSelected]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-on-selected-attribute), [`[SettingOnChanged]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-on-changed-attribute) or [`[SettingOnEnabled]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-on-enabled-attribute) are subscribed. Throws `ArgumentNullException` for `null`; every other problem is logged and that one member skipped. See [C# Setting Listeners](/docs/csharp/setting-listeners).
members.SaveSettings(): Writes the player-level saved settings file now.

IGlobalModSettingsTab.summary: A tab in the mod's settings page. A tab is not a setting.
IGlobalModSettingsTab.description:
A tab in the mod's settings page. A tab is not a setting: it has a tooltip rather than a caption
and description, and no preview or restart scope.

members.Name: Gets the tab's identity within the mod.
members.DisplayKey: Gets the localization key for the tab label. Falls back to `Name`.
members.TooltipKey: Gets or sets the localization key for the hover text.
members.CreateCategory(String, String): Creates a category with the given name and display key. Throws `ArgumentException` on a duplicate name.
members.GetOrCreateCategory(String, String): Returns the existing category, or creates it.
members.AddCategory(IGlobalModSettingsCategory): Adds an existing category object. Returns `false` if the name is taken.
members.RemoveCategory(String): Removes the category with that name. Returns whether one was removed.
members.RemoveCategory(IGlobalModSettingsCategor: Removes that category. Returns whether it was removed.
members.GetAllModSettings(): Returns every setting in every category of this tab, categories included, as a `List<`[`IGlobalModSetting`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-mod-setting)`>`.

IGlobalModSettingsCategory.summary: A category inside a tab. A category is itself a global setting.
IGlobalModSettingsCategory.description:
A category inside a tab. A category is itself a global setting, which gives it a caption,
description and preview image; its `RestartScope` always reads `None`.

members.GetSetting<T>(String): Returns the setting named `name` as `T`, or `null` if there is none or it is not a `T`. `T` must be a class implementing [`IGlobalModSetting`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-mod-setting).
members.CreateSetting<T>(String, String): Creates a setting of interface `T` with the given name and display key. Throws `ArgumentException` if `T` is not a known setting interface, `InvalidOperationException` if its value type has no implementation or no registered parser, and `ArgumentException` on a duplicate name.
members.GetOrCreateSetting<T>(String, String): Returns the existing setting as `T`, or creates it.
members.AddSetting(IGlobalModSetting): Adds an existing setting object. Returns `false` if the name is taken.
members.RemoveSetting(String): Removes the setting with that name. Returns whether one was removed.
members.RemoveSetting(IGlobalModSetting): Removes that setting. Returns whether it was removed.
members.GetAllSettings(): Returns the category itself followed by its settings, as a `List<`[`IGlobalModSetting`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-mod-setting)`>`.

IGlobalModSetting.summary: A setting that belongs to the player rather than to a world.
IGlobalModSetting.description:
A setting that belongs to the player rather than to a world: it knows its tab and category, can
warn about a reload or restart, and raises `OnSettingChanged` when applied.

members.RestartScope: Gets or sets what a change costs the player, as a [`SettingRestartScope`](/docs/reference/settings/setting-restart-scope): `None`, `Reload` or `Restart`. Always `None` on a category.
members.Category: Gets the [`IGlobalModSettingsCategory`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-mod-settings-category) this setting belongs to.
members.Tab: Gets the [`IGlobalModSettingsTab`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-mod-settings-tab) this setting belongs to.
members.OnSettingChanged: Occurs when `ApplyCurrentChange()` runs, whether or not the value differs. Type [`OnSettingChangedEvent`](/docs/reference/global/on-setting-changed-event).

OnSettingChangedEvent.description:
Handler for [`IGlobalModSetting`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-mod-setting)`.OnSettingChanged`. Carries no value; read `SettingValue`
from the setting if it is a value setting.

IGlobalValueSetting<T>.summary: A global setting that holds a value of type `T`, with the applied-value event.
IGlobalValueSetting<T>.description:
A global setting that holds a value of type `T`. Adds the applied-value event to
[`IValueModSetting<T>`](/docs/reference/settings/i-value-mod-setting).

members.OnValueChanged: Occurs when `SettingValue` changes to a different value: when the player saves, when a saved value is restored, or when code assigns it. Type [`ValueChangedEvent<T>`](/docs/reference/global/value-changed-event).

members.param:setting: The setting whose applied value changed. Note the parameter type is `IValueModSetting<T>`, not `IGlobalValueSetting<T>`; listener methods must match it exactly.

ISelectorGlobalSetting<T>.summary: A global setting chosen from a list of allowed values.
ISelectorGlobalSetting<T>.description:
A global setting chosen from a list of allowed values. Implemented for `int`, `float`, `string`
and any enum. An enum selector starts with every declared member as its allowed values.

members.SetAllowedValues(T[]): Replaces the allowed values with `values`, in that order.
members.SetAllowedValues(T, T, T): Replaces the allowed values with `min`, `min + increment`, … up to and including `max`. `increment` must be greater than 0 and `min` no greater than `max`, or the call is logged and ignored. Logged and ignored on a non-numeric `T`.
members.GetAllowedValues(): Returns the allowed values as `T[]`, in selection order. The matching entry in `GetAllowedValuesDisplay()` is how each one is shown.

ISliderGlobalSetting<T>.summary: A global numeric setting dragged within a range. `int` and `float` only.
ISliderGlobalSetting<T>.description: A global numeric setting dragged within a range. Implemented for `int` and `float` only.

members.Increment: Gets the step between values. `default(T)` until `SetAllowedValues` is called.

ISwitchGlobalSetting<T>.description:
A global two-position setting. Implemented for `bool` (left `false`, right `true`), `string` (no
sides until `SetSwitchValues`) and any enum (left and right are the first two declared members).

members.LeftValue: Gets or sets the value the left button selects.
members.RightValue: Gets or sets the value the right button selects.

IColorSelectorGlobalSetting.description:
A global colour picker. Adds no members of its own; everything comes from
[`IGlobalValueSetting<T>`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-value-setting) with `T` = `UnityEngine.Color`. Serialized as `R,G,B` in 0–255.
Only the setting's own preview image is shown.

IControlBindingSetting.summary: A global key-binding row. Not a value setting.
IControlBindingSetting.description:
A global key-binding row. Not a value setting: it has no `SettingValue`, is not saved by Gears,
and returns an empty string from `modsetting()`. The mod attaches the game `PlayerAction` the row
rebinds.

members.PlayerAction: Gets or sets the `InControl.PlayerAction` this row rebinds. `null` until the mod assigns it.

IModWorldSettings.summary: The root of a mod's world settings. No tab level; categories sit directly here.
IModWorldSettings.description:
The root of a mod's world settings. There is no tab level; categories sit directly here. Handed
to [`IGearsModApi`](/docs/reference/settings/i-gears-mod-api)`.OnWorldSettingsLoaded`; also [`IGearsMod`](/docs/reference/settings/i-gears-mod)`.WorldSettings`.

members.CreateCategory(String, String): Creates a category with the given name and display key. Throws `ArgumentException` on a duplicate name.
members.GetOrCreateCategory(String, String): Returns the existing category, or creates it.
members.AddCategory(IWorldModSettingsCategory): Adds an existing category object. Returns `false` if the name is taken.
members.RemoveCategory(String): Removes the category with that name. Returns whether one was removed.
members.RemoveCategory(IWorldModSettingsCategory: Removes that category. Returns whether it was removed.
members.GetAllWorldSettings(): Returns every setting in every category, categories included, as a `List<`[`IWorldModSetting`](/docs/reference/world/i-world-mod-setting)`>`.
members.BindSettingsClass(Type): Scans `settingsType` for tagged static members carrying a `"Category.Setting"` path. Fields and properties tagged [`[Setting]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-attribute) are assigned the named setting first, then methods tagged [`[SettingOnSelected]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-on-selected-attribute) or [`[SettingOnEnabled]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-on-enabled-attribute) are subscribed. [`[SettingOnValueChanged]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-on-value-changed-attribute) and [`[SettingOnChanged]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-on-changed-attribute) are logged and skipped: world settings have neither event. Throws `ArgumentNullException` for `null`. Re-binding a field on a later world load is harmless; re-subscribing a listener adds a second handler.
members.SaveSettings(): Writes the player-level saved settings file. World values themselves are written to the save folder by the world settings screen and on world start, not by this call.

IWorldModSettingsCategory.summary: A category of world settings. Like its global counterpart, itself a setting.
IWorldModSettingsCategory.description: A category of world settings. Like its global counterpart, a category is itself a setting.

members.GetSetting<T>(String): Returns the setting named `name` as `T`, or `null` if there is none or it is not a `T`. `T` must be a class implementing [`IWorldModSetting`](/docs/reference/world/i-world-mod-setting).
members.CreateSetting<T>(String, String): Creates a setting of interface `T`. Same exceptions as the global version. Setting names must be unique across **all** of the mod’s world categories, because saved world values are looked up by name alone.
members.GetOrCreateSetting<T>(String, String): Returns the existing setting as `T`, or creates it.
members.AddSetting(IWorldModSetting): Adds an existing setting object. Returns `false` if the name is taken.
members.RemoveSetting(String): Removes the setting with that name.
members.GetAllSettings(): Returns the category itself followed by its settings, as a `List<`[`IWorldModSetting`](/docs/reference/world/i-world-mod-setting)`>`.

IWorldModSetting.summary: A setting that belongs to a save. No `RestartScope`, no `OnSettingChanged`.
IWorldModSetting.description: A setting that belongs to a save. Has no `RestartScope` and no `OnSettingChanged`.

members.Category: Gets the [`IWorldModSettingsCategory`](/docs/reference/world/i-world-mod-settings-category) this setting belongs to.

ISelectorWorldSetting<T>.summary: A world setting chosen from a list of allowed values.
ISelectorWorldSetting<T>.description:
A world setting chosen from a list of allowed values. Implemented for `int`, `float`, `string`
and any enum. Raises `OnSelected` only; there is no `OnValueChanged` on world settings.

members.SetAllowedValues(T[]): Replaces the allowed values with `values`, in that order.
members.SetAllowedValues(T, T, T): Replaces the allowed values with the range `min` to `max` in steps of `increment`. Same validation as the global version.

ISliderWorldSetting<T>.summary: A world numeric setting within a range. `int` and `float` only.
ISliderWorldSetting<T>.description: A world numeric setting within a range. Implemented for `int` and `float` only.

ISwitchWorldSetting<T>.description:
A world two-position setting. Implemented for `bool`, `string` and any enum, with the same side
defaults as the global version.

members.LeftValue: Gets or sets the value the left button selects.
members.RightValue: Gets or sets the value the right button selects.

SettingPathAttribute.summary: Base class of every attribute that names a setting by its path.
SettingPathAttribute.description:
Base class of every attribute that names a setting by its path for `BindSettingsClass`.
Cannot be applied directly. It declares no `AttributeUsage` of its own, because `AttributeUsage` is
inherited — each concrete attribute below it declares its own targets.

members.SettingPathAttribute(String): Protected. Stores `settingPath`. Throws `ArgumentException` if it is `null` or whitespace.
members.SettingPath: Gets the dot-separated path to the setting: `"Tab.Category.Setting"` for global settings, `"Category.Setting"` for world settings.

SettingAttribute.summary: Binds a static field or property to the setting its path names.
SettingAttribute.description:
Binds a static field or property to the setting its path names. `BindSettingsClass` assigns
the resolved setting into the member before it subscribes any listener on the same type. The member
must be static, and its declared type must be one the setting actually implements — anything from
[`IModSetting`](/docs/reference/settings/i-mod-setting) down to the concrete class. A field must additionally be
neither `readonly` nor `const`; a property must additionally have a setter, which may be private.
Anything else is logged and skipped. See [C# Setting Listeners](/docs/csharp/setting-listeners).

members.SettingAttribute(String): Initializes the attribute with the setting path.

SettingListenerAttribute.summary: Base class of the four attributes that bind a static method to a setting's event.
SettingListenerAttribute.description:
Base class of the four attributes that bind a static method to a setting's event through
`BindSettingsClass`. Cannot be applied directly.

members.SettingListenerAttribute(String): Protected. Passes `settingPath` to the base constructor.

SettingOnValueChangedAttribute.summary: Binds a static method to `OnValueChanged`. Global value settings only.
SettingOnValueChangedAttribute.description:
Binds a static method to the named setting's `OnValueChanged` event
([`IGlobalValueSetting<T>`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-value-setting)), which fires when the applied value changes. Global value
settings only. Required method signature:
`static void M(IValueModSetting<T> setting, T newValue)`.

members.SettingOnValueChangedAttribute(String): Initializes the attribute with the setting path.

SettingOnSelectedAttribute.summary: Binds a static method to `OnSelected`. Global and world value settings.
SettingOnSelectedAttribute.description:
Binds a static method to the named setting's `OnSelected` event
([`IValueModSetting<T>`](/docs/reference/settings/i-value-mod-setting)), which fires when the value selected in the UI changes. Global and
world value settings. Required method signature:
`static void M(IValueModSetting<T> setting, T newValue)`.

members.SettingOnSelectedAttribute(String): Initializes the attribute with the setting path.

SettingOnChangedAttribute.summary: Binds a static method to `OnSettingChanged`. Global settings only.
SettingOnChangedAttribute.description:
Binds a static method to the named setting's `OnSettingChanged` event
([`IGlobalModSetting`](/docs/reference/global/i-global-mod-setting)), which fires when the setting is applied. Global settings only,
including Color and Binding. Required method signature: `static void M(IGlobalModSetting setting)`.

members.SettingOnChangedAttribute(String): Initializes the attribute with the setting path.

SettingOnEnabledAttribute.summary: Binds a static method to `OnEnabled`. Works on every setting.
SettingOnEnabledAttribute.description:
Binds a static method to the named setting's `OnEnabled` event ([`IModSetting`](/docs/reference/settings/i-mod-setting)), which
fires when `Enabled` changes to a different value. Declared on `IModSetting`, so it is the one
listener that works on every setting, global and world. Required method signature:
`static void M(IModSetting setting, bool isEnabled)`.

members.SettingOnEnabledAttribute(String): Initializes the attribute with the setting path.

SettingsSerializationProvider.summary: Marks a class as holding `[SettingParser]` and `[SettingFormatter]` methods.
SettingsSerializationProvider.description:
Marks a class as holding [`[SettingParser]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-parser-attribute) and
[`[SettingFormatter]`](/docs/reference/attributes/setting-formatter-attribute) methods. Gears scans every loaded
assembly for classes with this attribute at `GameAwake`. The class name has no `Attribute`
suffix; write `[SettingsSerializationProvider]`. See
[C# Custom Value Types](/docs/csharp/custom-value-types).

SettingParserAttribute.summary: Marks a static method as the parser for a value type.
SettingParserAttribute.description:
Marks a static method inside a
[`[SettingsSerializationProvider]`](/docs/reference/attributes/settings-serialization-provider) class as the parser for
a value type. The method must have the signature `static T Method(string)`; a mismatch throws
`InvalidOperationException` when Gears scans it.
SettingParserAttribute.note: Declared in `SettingsParserAttribute.cs` — the file name carries an extra `s` that the type name does not.

members.ValueType: Gets the type the method parses.

SettingFormatterAttribute.summary: Marks a static method as the formatter for a value type.
SettingFormatterAttribute.description:
Marks a static method inside a
[`[SettingsSerializationProvider]`](/docs/reference/attributes/settings-serialization-provider) class as the formatter
for a value type. The method must have the signature `static string Method(T value, string format)`,
where `format` is the setting's UI or serialization formatter string and may be `null`; a
mismatch throws `InvalidOperationException` when Gears scans it.

members.ValueType: Gets the type the method formats.

SettingFactoryAttribute.summary: Registers a setting family implementation for one value type. **Reserved.**
SettingFactoryAttribute.description:
Registers a class as the implementation of a setting family for one value type, for example
`[SettingFactory(typeof(ISelectorGlobalSetting<>), typeof(int))]`.

members.SettingFactoryAttribute(Type, Type): Initializes the attribute with the open generic family interface and the value type.
members.FamilyInterface: Gets the open generic setting interface, such as `typeof(`[`ISelectorGlobalSetting<>`](/docs/reference/global/i-selector-global-setting)`)`.
members.ValueType: Gets the value type the class implements the family for.

SettingFactoryEnumAttribute.summary: Registers a setting family implementation for every enum. **Reserved.**
SettingFactoryEnumAttribute.description:
Registers an open generic class with one type parameter as the implementation of a setting
family for every enum.

members.SettingFactoryEnumAttribute(Type): Initializes the attribute with the open generic family interface.
members.FamilyInterface: Gets the open generic setting interface.

SettingFactoryFixedAttribute.summary: Registers an implementation of a non-generic setting interface. **Reserved.**
SettingFactoryFixedAttribute.description:
Registers a class as the implementation of a non-generic setting interface such as
[`IColorSelectorGlobalSetting`](/docs/reference/global/i-color-selector-global-setting) or [`IControlBindingSetting`](/docs/reference/global/i-control-binding-setting).

members.SettingFactoryFixedAttribute(Type): Initializes the attribute with the setting interface it implements.
members.KeyInterface: Gets the non-generic setting interface the class implements.
